`github.com/bide-ai/bide/model/openai` · [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bide-ai/bide/model/openai) · Stability: **stable**

Package openai adapts the OpenAI Chat Completions API to agent.Model.

## type Model

```go
type Model struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Model is an OpenAI Chat Completions API adapter implementing agent.Model.

**Constructors and functions**

- `func New(apiKey string, opts ...Option) *Model`: New constructs an OpenAI-compatible adapter.

**Methods**

- `func (m *Model) Describe() agent.ModelInfo`: Describe reports the adapter's identity: provider "openai" (the Chat Completions API, also when WithBaseURL points it at a compatible server), the configured model ID, and support for a JSON-schema response format.
- `func (m Model) Format(f fmt.State, _ rune)`: Format writes String for every verb, so no fmt verb (%v, %+v, %#v, %s, %x, ...) prints the key.
- `func (m *Model) RequiresToolsForRequired() bool`: RequiresToolsForRequired implements agent.ToolRules: OpenAI refuses tool choice "required" with no tools declared.
- `func (m *Model) Stream(ctx context.Context, req agent.Request) (*agent.Stream, error)`: Stream implements agent.Model.
- `func (m Model) String() string`: String describes the adapter by its model id.
- `func (m *Model) ToolNameRule() *regexp.Regexp`: ToolNameRule implements agent.ToolRules: the tool names OpenAI accepts, `^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$`, so agent.New refuses any other name when the agent is built.

## type Option

```go
type Option func(*Model)
```

Option configures a Model in New.

**Constructors and functions**

- `func WithBaseURL(u string) Option`: WithBaseURL sets the API host, for a proxy or a compatible endpoint; /chat/completions is appended to it.
- `func WithHTTPClient(c *http.Client) Option`: WithHTTPClient sets the HTTP client requests are sent with.
- `func WithMaxCompletionTokens(use bool) Option`: WithMaxCompletionTokens chooses the request field that carries the token limit (WithMaxTokens, or Sampling.MaxTokens): max\_completion\_tokens when use is true, max\_tokens when false.
- `func WithMaxResponseBytes(n int64) Option`: WithMaxResponseBytes caps how many bytes of one streamed reply the adapter reads: a reply that runs longer fails with agent.ErrResponseTooLarge, which middleware.Retryable does not retry.
- `func WithMaxTokens(n int) Option`: WithMaxTokens sets the default limit on tokens in a reply; a request's Sampling.MaxTokens overrides it.
- `func WithModel(id string) Option`: WithModel sets the model ID sent with every request.
- `func WithStrictSchema() Option`: WithStrictSchema sends every tool's input schema in OpenAI strict mode, rewritten by schema.OpenAIStrict.
- `func WithToolResultCodec(c provider.ToolResultCodec) Option`: WithToolResultCodec encodes tool results sent to the model with c instead of raw JSON (for example GCF, to cut tokens on structured output).
